identity.receipt_id: source-quality- + sha256('source-quality/v1\0' + tenant_id + '\0' + rail + '\0' + consumer_group + '\0' + topic + '\0' + partition + '\0' + offset)
identity.tenant_policy: tenant_id is mandatory and part of receipt identity
identity.collision_policy: same receipt_id with any different field fails closed

receipt.source_hash: lowercase SHA-256 of the admitted source payload bytes
receipt.watermark_unit: unix epoch milliseconds or Long.MIN_VALUE when uninitialized

offset_barrier.receipt_failure: return error and do not invoke source offset commit
offset_barrier.offset_failure: retain immutable receipt and retry the same tuple idempotently
offset_barrier.kafka_checkpoint: Flink writers must publish the receipt in the checkpoint transaction that advances source offsets

reconciliation.committed_range: every offset in [first_offset, committed_next_offset) has exactly one receipt
reconciliation.extra_policy: receipt offset outside the committed range is visible failure
reconciliation.missing_signal: BuildMissingReceipts emits category=missing with MISSING_SOURCE_RECEIPT for committed offsets without a receipt
reconciliation.pass: ReconcileAllRails requires all four rail expectations, no missing offsets, no extra offsets and zero lag

rollout.kubernetes: no production resource is changed until all four writers and audit materializer are candidate-bound
rollout.rollback: disable receipt writers and redeploy the prior immutable images; preserve audit receipts and Kafka offsets
